headline: NPR finds open models stripped of safeguards in minutes
body: A quiet day. NPR documented thousands of altered open-weight models used for scams and extremism, and showed safeguards on Gemma 3 and Llama 3.3 can be removed with public tools. That chips at Alignment & Control, pulling Protector God down by a few hundredths. Horizon Balance is 0.9, down 0.04.
movers_note: Only small moves today: Protector God -0.08, from the NPR report (-0.05) and fading earlier news (-0.03); Enslaved God -0.08, from the NPR report (-0.04) and fading earlier news (-0.04).
